phases.objective: Make governed Promotion convergence bind every builder, exact-validation, and ai_policy supporting run to the workflow-dispatch response that created it, eliminating time-sensitive run-list discovery races while retaining bounded fallback and fail-closed behavior.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A bounded ai_policy Promotion convergence attempt dispatches the candidate builder, exact validation, and allowlisted supporting gates for one exact candidate SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Each dispatch returns an exact run ID captured from its response URL; the launcher polls that run directly, records attempt/run provenance, retains bounded discovery only as fallback, and fails closed without closing a candidate on ambiguous dispatch transport.
steps: Pin the current main, Production, release, validation, and validation-base refs for one convergence attempt.
Dispatch the candidate builder and capture its workflow run ID directly from the dispatch response URL.
Create the exact candidate surfaces and dispatch exact validation on the validation branch, capturing its run ID directly.
Poll exact validation by the captured run ID and require successful completion before supporting-gate resolution.
In ai_policy mode, dispatch each allowlisted supporting workflow on the exact release branch and capture each run ID directly.
Poll every captured supporting run to successful completion and record the exact IDs in convergence evidence.
Use bounded list discovery only when direct response capture is unavailable, and preserve fail-closed behavior for missing or ambiguous runs.
Perform final protected-ref and candidate readbacks before publishing evidence; no Production mutation is authorized.
assertions: Candidate-builder and exact-validation run IDs are not selected solely by a later time-sensitive gh run list query.
Each ai_policy supporting gate is bound to the exact candidate SHA and release branch.
A dispatch response without a parseable run URL is treated as a bounded failure and does not trigger blind mutation or deployment.
The launcher retains transient API retry and settle-readback behavior.
The launcher still requires exact validation and all six supporting workflows.
No Production merge, deployment, SQL, migration, grant, provider, credential, secret, or protected-ref write authority is added by this repair.

phases.objective: Record direct dispatch run IDs and fallback provenance in canonical convergence evidence across retries without weakening exact-head validation.
Exercise delayed workflow registration, transient dispatch transport errors, and canceled runs while proving no blind duplicate dispatch occurs.
This orchestration repair has no provider or live-runtime canary authority.
This repair does not authorize Production merge, deployment, database mutation, migration apply, grant apply, or provider mutation.
